commitRule: a route must begin at an outer bank, enter the central void, and exit the opposite bank
memoryRule: preview is geometry-neutral; a valid through-void cut shifts a remote volume in depth, widens a remote void, and tightens the seam field; four cuts persist
interactionRule: pointer or touch draws from an outer bank through the central void to the opposite bank; ArrowLeft then ArrowRight plus Enter uses the same route; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: Canvas 2D opposing clasp, one-way pressure field, and witness-body exchange -> p5.js 1.11.3 WebGL extruded mass with real depth and negative voids
compositionRupture: planar radial clasp, horizontal strata, and vertical witness body -> tilted shallow monolith organized by a deep central absence and rear-lit cut volumes
encounterRupture: opposing jaws, one-way edge traversal, and two-site call/reply -> a path through an existing void that must leave at the opposite bank
temporalRupture: two-sided compression and one-time release -> reversible through-cuts whose remote depth and void geometry compound across four events
mediumRupture: p5.js Canvas 2D polygons, seams, and raster-like fields -> p5.js WebGL boxes, lighting, z displacement, torus voids, and generated depth structure
changedRule: A passage is inert until it enters the central void and exits the opposite bank. Only a complete through-cut spends material as remote depth displacement and a widened absence.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is a dark three-dimensional painted monolith with nine irregular masses, five holes, seams, and a deep centre. A valid cut leaves the hand path absent while a remote mass moves in z and a different void opens; four cuts remain visible.
falsifier: Delete if a bypass commits, if a same-bank route commits, if the hand path is painted, if the entry site answers itself, if depth changes only in readout, or if later cuts reset earlier changes.
deletionCondition: Delete v046 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the depth-cut monolith from v043-v045 or if the through-absence rule is merely explanatory prose.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
